correctness.rationale: Solving the centered two-state backward generator with a competing-rate sticky-wall condition gives an exact midpoint Laplace transform. Its Taylor coefficients yield the mean and variance, confirmed independently by backward first- and second-moment boundary equations. The rational CV derivative has positive denominator and affine numerator Q-2ka/3, proving one optimum iff Q>0 and monotonicity otherwise for all a>=0, k,g>0. The standalone checker passed 294 exact-rational cases; finite checks are auxiliary.

value.rationale: A natural transport-reliability question is whether tuning a swimmer's tumble rate reduces relative absorption-time uncertainty when sticking walls allow both release and killing. The theorem gives a full sharp two-wall-kinetic-parameter phase diagram, uniqueness, threshold, and an unavoidable mean/dispersion tradeoff—not a single numerical optimum. It complements preexisting mean-escape results.
